class: A waiting note proved only that a run had waited once, so the dashboard offered Continue on runs long dead
fix: The wait loop touches its waiting note every poll (browser_automation._touch_waiting_note), and waiting_runs lists only notes touched within five minutes. A run killed mid-wait leaves a note that quietly ages out instead of a Continue nobody reads.
prevention: Liveness signals are heartbeats, not tombstones: anything the dashboard offers an action on must prove its run is still alive.
root_cause: wait_for_signal wrote its _waiting_ note once at wait entry and only removed it on a clean exit; a run whose process died mid-wait left the note behind untouched, and the dashboard listed every note as a waiting run. Analog Devices' 3 November runs left such a fossil while no run was alive.
site: Owner wait handoff, browser_automation.py + web_ui.py, 3 November 2026
symptom: The dashboard offered Continue for a waiting run after its process was gone; pressing it wrote a signal no run would ever read.
why_tests_missed: Waiting-note tests wrote the note and read it back in the same breath, never asking what it means hours after its run died.
